name: Rune-Inscribed Parchment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Read the Rune-Inscribed Parchment and speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText: You will be the conduit in which our ancestors communicate. You will have the power of the elements at your beck and call. Sundering your enemies will be child's play; healing your allies as easy as breathing. Keep these things in mind as you face new challenges, and come back to me as often as you'd like. I will remain here to teach you new spells and set you on the correct path when you are ready.
narrative.requestItemsText:
So, you've arrived. I was beginning to wonder when you would show yourself. I sent the parchment some time ago--I wasn't sure if it had arrived.

But enough chatter... you're here because you have been chosen, chosen to lead the spiritual lives of our people.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Rune-Inscribed Parchment
quests.objectiveText: Read the Rune-Inscribed Parchment and speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
